architectureSubpages.name: Architecture 1 - Four-Layer Boundary, Runtime Topology & Dependency Law
Architecture 2 - Ivory Core: Research Objects, Provenance, Temporal Semantics & Storage
Architecture 3 - Ivory Compute: Governed R/Python/Quarto, Environments, Jobs & Reproducibility
Architecture 4 - Ivory Studio: Theia Composition, Visual Research UX & Code Workbench
Architecture 5 - IDE Bridge: Project Files, CLI, MCP & External IDE Interoperability
Architecture 6 - Ingestion, AI, Security, Measurement, Recovery & Release Evidence

included: Ivory Core - research semantics, citations, protocols, lenses, claims, temporal and identity objects, protected records, manifests and provenance; imports zero Theia and zero Compute/Studio adapters.
Ivory Compute - governed R / Python / Quarto execution over frozen corpus snapshots with exact execution provenance; imports zero Studio.
Ivory Studio - a single custom Eclipse Theia application (Electron-first) exposing one guided visual workflow and one code-capable workbench over the same Core/Compute contract.
IDE Bridge - a documented portable project root, a stable Ivory CLI, and a local MCP server; RStudio / Positron / VS Code / Cursor / Codex are first-class V1 clients.
Lexical (PostgreSQL) retrieval baseline; content-addressed source admission; Docling normalization.
A governed code lane for quantitative / survey analysis.

Executable release-evidence gates for architecture separation, compute, identity/citations, retrieval, research semantics, AI safety, protected authorship, recovery, reproducibility, usability, and accessibility.
excluded: The browser build as a shipped or hosted production surface - it exists for development and automated testing only.
Hosted, remote, team, role-based, or multi-tenant deployment.
Making Ivory Studio mandatory for researchers who prefer another IDE.
Silent model-autonomous shell, package, or network access.
Unreviewed arbitrary MCP servers or extensions in the trusted/default Studio profile; an enabled or unrestricted plugin host.
Automatic statistical interpretation, causal claims, unrestricted model selection, or treating an installed package as method validation.
Broad connectors, live credentialed acquisition, a model marketplace, and automatic provider routing.
Vector / visual retrieval (evidence-gated), a specialized survey wizard UI (deferred), and hosted collaboration (deferred).
Full feature parity with every RStudio, Positron, VS Code, Jupyter, Cursor, or Codex capability.
Universal support claims across languages, formats, methods, or disciplines without release evidence.
Representing any post-V1 capability as V1 completion.

authority.evidenceRule: No Ivory Tower V1 issue, session, or release gate advances on a Notion status, a planning page, or a document that asserts completion. Only committed, reproducible repository evidence advances work: source code, tests, and the artifacts under release-evidence/ and docs/sessions/, reproducible by another engineer from a clean checkout. Source, static-analysis, local-runtime, hosted-CI, and release evidence are reported separately and never substituted for one another. The legacy Notion issue tracker and every IV-# issue are frozen historical input; Session 00 modifies none of them.
